# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-11-10

- First version: Zapier remote MCP server over streamable HTTP, with OAuth sign-in.
- Added the 4 skills, the agent and the always-on rule published in `zapier/zapier-mcp` (commit `54a12277`), copied unchanged, with Zapier's MIT licence in `skills/LICENSE`.
